title: 'When I die in combat, choose an opponent. They score 1 point.' never fires
expected: draven-audacious.ts:4-18 declares no `abilities`, so enrich-cards.ts:30 runs parseAbilities on rulesText at load. Running the parser on the exact rulesText yields only [{keyword:"Deflect"}, {type:"spell", timing:"action", effect:{type:"score", player:"opponent", amount:1}}] — no triggered ability with a die/die-in-combat trigger (and the win-combat trigger is dropped too). With no death trigger on the card, the engine has nothing to fire when Draven dies in combat, matching the observed no pendingChoice / no chain item / VP unchanged.
observed: Draven moved to trash, battlefield uncontrolled, player-2 VP stayed 0; no pendingChoice, no chain item. Parsed abilities contain no die-in-combat trigger (the sentence was mis-parsed into a bare 'spell' score-opponent effect).
